subtitle: Install the slash command, save your GitHub PAT, manage VelocityAI API keys.

sections.body: Run on each machine where you use Claude Code. Idempotent — safe to re-run to pull updates.
Needs repo scope. Encrypted at rest, never returned by any API.
Used by the slash command / MCP client. Plaintext shown once.

shell: own chrome — no app nav rendered
notes: the PAT field is type=password, so the value is masked in the DOM but still readable via .value
install command points at the backend origin (localhost:8000), not the frontend
most security-sensitive surface in the product; not described by routes.ts
